// diagnostic

E0736

`#Scrub({tag})` does not match this function signature.

What

`#Scrub({tag})` does not match this function signature.

Why

A scrubber removes exactly one tag, so it must consume a value carrying that tag and return a value without it.

Fix

Accept a `#{tag} T` parameter and return the untagged result.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0736: tests/ui/tag_bad_scrub_signature.stderr.

Error [E0736]: `#Scrub(PII)` does not match this function signature
  --> tests/ui/tag_bad_scrub_signature.jet:3:4
    |
  3 | fn scrub(value: String) => String :: "redacted"
    |    ^^^^^
 Why: a scrubber consumes a value carrying that tag and returns a value without it
 Fix: accept a `#PII T` parameter and return the untagged result
